angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 653,958 km at 9.61 pc = 0.91 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 101501: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 104.03 +/- 0.26 mas, inverted (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/746/1/101): 9.613 +/- 0.024 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 104.4252 +/- 0.1005 mas (same row, RUWE 1.14), 1039.1 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 0.94 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 101501: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 0.91 +/- 0.009 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 0.94 +/- 0.01 (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/746/1/101): 653,958 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5270 +/- 32 K from Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 101501: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 5270 +/- 32 (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/746/1/101). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 101501: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 5270 +/- 32 (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/746/1/101)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 4.42 from 2025A&A...698A..93J; the 46 published values span log g 4.34 to 4.69, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.1% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A%26A...698A..93J)
luminositySource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4025850731201819392, flags_flame 00: lum_flame 0.6305987 solar luminosities (16th to 84th percentiles 0.62544936 to 0.6357354); its log10 is recorded
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4025850731201819392, flags_flame 00: age_flame 10.401634 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 8.886345 to 11.916627)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, * 61 UMa: projected rotation speed 3.26 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2010A&A...520A..79M)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
